text: dsh-ui-peak-rate 是一款 DSH 网页客户端界面插件，会在聊天输入框右侧显示 DeepSeek 高峰费率徽标。它读取当前会话的模型提供方和型号，并结合配置的提供方列表、UTC 高峰时段与北京时间周末规则判断是否显示；匹配时呈现火焰图标和倍率，提示文字列出时段。默认提供方为 deepseek-official，默认时段为 01:00–04:00 与 06:00–10:00 UTC，倍率为 2，也可通过配置调整。徽标每分钟重新计算，周末全天不显示。适合希望在 DSH 网页中查看当前是否处于 DeepSeek 高峰计费时段的用户。安装后无需 API 密钥或额外外部账号。

dsh-ui-peak-rate displays a DeepSeek rate badge in the DSH web composer. It checks the selected provider, model, and UTC time; Beijing weekends are off-peak. The badge shows a multiplier and refreshes each minute. Defaults: deepseek-official, 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, 2×. No key is needed.
想在聊天输入框旁看到当前是不是 DeepSeek 高峰费率。
能不能根据所选模型和时段显示费用倍率提醒？
让 DSH 网页在模型处于高峰计费时间时标出倍率。
dsh-ui-peak-rate 的功能「输入栏高峰倍率徽标」：在会话的聊天输入框右侧显示火焰倍率标记。仅当当前 provider 与配置列表匹配、模型名含 DeepSeek 且当前为工作日高峰时段才显示，并每分钟更新。
dsh-ui-peak-rate 的功能「费率策略配置」：可设置 provider、UTC 高峰时段及倍率；默认时段为 01:00–04:00 和 06:00–10:00，倍率为 2，周末按北京时间全天低峰处理。

DSH web composer 🔥 2× peak-rate badge — shows when the session's model selection matches a DeepSeek peak-rate route during DeepSeek peak hours.

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · Introduction：A web client plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It paints a `🔥 2×` pill in the composer's trailing input row, just left of the model trigger, when **both** of these hold:

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · Introduction：1. The session's current model selection matches the DeepSeek peak-rate policy (see [Match rule](#match-rule)).
2. The current time is peak-priced: a **weekday** (Monday–Friday, Beijing time) whose UTC hour is inside a DeepSeek peak window (by default `01:00–04:00 UTC` or `06:00–10:00 UTC`, configurable).

Weekends (Saturday and Sunday, Beijing time) are all-day off-peak per the billing rule effective 2026-08-23, so the badge never shows then.

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · Introduction：- **Clock-only, no side effects.** The badge reads the local clock and the existing model-directory store — no model-visible output, no session events, no durable state.
- **Weekends never badge.** Saturday and Sunday (Beijing time) are all-day off-peak per the billing rule, so the pill never shows then.
- **Configurable, fail-loud.** Providers, peak windows, and multiplier come from `cordis.patch.yml`; invalid windows (`start >= end`, `start < 0`, `end > 24`) fail at load, and `peakWindows: []` disables the badge entirely.
- **Fresh every 60 s.** The component re-evaluates on an interval (cleared on unmount) and immediately when config arrives; hidden until the one-shot policy fetch settles.

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · Introduction：For example:

```text
Mon 02:30 UTC (Beijing Mon 10:30, a weekday) + model `deepseek-chat` on `deepseek-official`
→ composer shows:  🔥 2×

Sun 12:00 UTC (Beijing Sun 20:00, a weekend) → badge hidden, no layout cost

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:haoliangwu/dsh-ui-peak-rate
```

Built `lib/` is committed, so the git install is one line — no `prepare` script, no `allowBuilds` permission. Restart `dsh --profile web` after install (bundle layer stacks compose at boot).

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · Configure：All three fields default to the DeepSeek peak-rate policy; override any of them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: dsh-ui-peak-rate
  config:
    # Provider ids whose sessions may show the badge (default: ['deepseek-official'])
    providers:

An empty `peakWindows: []` disables the badge entirely (always off-peak). Invalid windows (`start >= end`, `start < 0`, or `end > 24`) fail loud at load.

Disable the badge entirely:

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · Configure：```yaml
- id: dsh-ui-peak-rate
  disabled: true
```

The host half reads `Config` (schemastery) and exposes it to the browser half through a Connection RPC channel (`/peak-rate` endpoint `config`). No transport carries host plugin Config into the browser context automatically; the RPC channel is the explicit transport.

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · Match rule：The badge shows when the session's current model selection satisfies **both** of:

- `state.current.provider ∈ Config.providers` (provider match, default `['deepseek-official']`), AND
- `state.current.model` contains `deepseek` (case-insensitive).

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · Match rule：The model-id check narrows the provider list so a non-DeepSeek model routed through a listed provider does not trigger the badge. To match a provider whose model ids do not contain `deepseek`, neither condition holds and the badge stays hidden — extend `Config.providers` only when the route actually serves DeepSeek peak-priced models.

dsh-ui-peak-rate README · How it works：- **Peak state is a pure client-side clock fact.** `isPeakRate(date, windows)` returns true iff the date is a **weekday** (Beijing time, UTC+8) whose UTC hour is inside one of the configured windows (left-closed, right-open). Weekends are all-day off-peak. The weekend boundary follows Beijing time — the billing rule's stated timezone — so Beijing Saturday 00:00 (UTC Friday 16:00) and Beijing Monday 00:00 (UTC Sunday 16:00) are classified correctly, not by their UTC weekday. The component re-evaluates every 60 s through a `setInterval` cleared on unmount, and re-evaluates immediately when the config arrives.
- **The peak-rate policy is fetched once from the host through a Connection RPC channel.** The host half registers `ctx.connection.rpc.handle('/peak-rate', ...)`, reads `Config` (schemastery: `providers`, `peakWindows`, `multiplier`) from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, and returns it on the `config` endpoint. The browser half calls `ctx.connection.rpc.call('/peak-rate', 'config', {})` once and exposes the result as a reactive source (`useSyncExternalStore`); the badge stays hidden until the fetch settles.
